name: Import and Configure an Exam
description: Import an exam from the Testing assessment tool (Mock LMS) and fully configure it in the SEB Server web interface. First, navigate to 'Exam Administration' under 'Exam' in the left sidebar. Click on 'Import from Assessment Tool' or similar import option to see available quizzes from the Testing LMS. Select any available quiz/exam from the list to import it. After importing, configure the exam: add a name description if not already set, and add a monitoring indicator of type 'Last Ping Time' named 'Network Latency'. Save all changes. The SEB Server is accessible at http://localhost:8080 with login credentials super-admin / admin. The demo environment includes a pre-configured Testing/Mock LMS with sample quizzes available for import.
